verdicts.critic_1: You built a magnificent credibility skin and a thin content body. Close #1–#7 (mind pillar, food, workout demos, the human, react/stitch, trending audio, search/YouTube) and you have a category-owning system.
verdicts.critic_2: Strong production/funnel architecture bolted onto a science layer that the exact skeptics it targets would screenshot and mock. Two existential cracks: (1) the five-element spine IS pancha-mahabhuta; (2) headline longevity hooks sell correlation as causation. The skeleton is top-1%; the evidence QA is not shippable as-is.

items.title: Wrong journal on a headline citation
items.fix: Mandsager 2018 is JAMA Network Open, not JAMA — fix wherever the OS wrote 'JAMA 2018'.

items.title: '2% dehydration = strength loss' overstated
items.fix: Robust effects: endurance, thermoregulation, cognition, RPE. Maximal-strength effect small (~2%) and inconsistent.

items.title: Leucine threshold conflated with protein dose
items.fix: Leucine threshold ≈ 2.5–3 g; ~20–40 g (~0.4 g/kg) is the PER-MEAL PROTEIN dose for MPS.

items.title: Pontzer 'stable 20–60' missing the size caveat
items.fix: True only AFTER adjusting for fat-free mass — say it or invite the 'then why did I gain at 40?' dunk.

items.title: 'Exercise = first-line antidepressant' is a medical overclaim
items.fix: Effective for mild–moderate / adjunctive; effect shrinks after publication-bias correction. Never 'first-line' as a brand claim.

items.title: Barrier ships as both 0.6 µm and 0.3 µm
items.fix: Lock ONE: ~0.3 µm at its thinnest (0.6 µm is the thicker tissue side). Retire the second number.

items.title: Water-% inconsistent across reference bodies
items.fix: 60 % / 42 L is a 70 kg MALE; a 60 kg female ≈ 50–55 % ≈ ~31 L. Never mix reference bodies in one asset.

items.title: 'Newbie gains are neural not muscular (Sale 1988)' is dated dogma
items.fix: Damas 2016: measurable hypertrophy earlier than the old model claimed; early 'growth' partly edema/damage, but growth is real sooner.

items.title: Creatine led as 'cell hydration' undersells
items.fix: Primary mechanism: phosphocreatine/ATP resynthesis (Kreider 2017). Volumization is secondary.

items.title: Cold immersion claim needs its context clause
items.fix: Blunting is for chronic post-resistance-training CWI; fine between events or for acute recovery needs.

items.title: 'Static stretch before lifting' absolutism
items.fix: Behm 2016: long holds (>45–60 s) transiently reduce force/power; short holds (<30 s) in a warm-up are trivial.

items.title: Adaptive thermogenesis sourced only to Biggest Loser
items.fix: That's an extreme rapid-loss outlier; pair with review work and bound the magnitude ('a few hundred kcal').
